text:
maria: FYI — this morning ~8:10 UTC a subset of HubSpot webhooks arrived but enrichment timed out; several leads were picked up by RR before enrichment completed. some SDRs saw duplicate claim notifications.
dan: saw it. enrichment returned 502s for a 6-minute window. HubSpot retried and our connector ended up handing raw rows to RR.

ashwin: proposal: add a lightweight "pre-route" validator that a) ACKs HubSpot immediately (so they mark it processing), b) verifies enrichment payload TTL + schema, c) if bad -> tag contact property `route_status=deferred` and push to retry queue, else forward to RR/SF. keeps sales clean.

lina: upstream question for comms: how will SDRs know a lead is deferred vs queued? we should have a property and a Slack digest for deferred items every 15m.

maria: agree. temporary mitigation: increase claim TTL from 2m -> 8m while we test so RR doesn't claim too fast.

ops-signal: add metrics: routing_precheck.defer_count, precheck.accept_latency_ms, enrichment.retry_rate. alert if defer_rate > 0.5% in 15m or enrichment.p95 > 3m. route alerts to infra-oncall.

ashwin: I can build a PoC lambda today. sync flow sample: HubSpot -> precheck ACK -> if valid forward to enrichment -> mark enriched -> route. if invalid -> set `route_status=deferred` + enqueue. I'll add a small curl test to simulate stale enrichment.

dan: also add a backfill Kibana saved search for leads with enrichment:timeout in last 24h so PMs can show examples to SDRs.

maria: rollout plan: 1) PoC staging + tests (ashwin) 2) metrics + alerting (ops) 3) 5% canary for 48h and SDR review 4) expand to 100% and revert TTL. Lina will run comms.

hubspot-bot: delivery log 08:12:36 UTC — 18 events, 4 retried, 3 failed (502).

lina: thanks, team. ping me if you need an SDR contact list for canary. :thumbsup:
